title: Bekhorot 60 - Counting Sheep

chapters.title: Counting 15 sheep for Ma'asar Behemah
chapters.about: Rava's ruling on insufficient animals and the obligation to keep them for the next gathering.

chapters.title: Challenging the ruling with 19 sheep
chapters.about: Comparing the 15-sheep case with a 19-sheep case and the concept of a fit count.

chapters.title: Rav Huna Bar Sechora's explanation
chapters.about: Explaining the 19-sheep Baraita using a pen with two openings.

chapters.title: Counting mistakes and simultaneous exits
chapters.about: Mishna regarding two animals exiting at once and the resulting status of the tenth and eleventh.

chapters.title: The status of the ninth, tenth, and eleventh animals
chapters.about: Analyzing the holiness of animals when the shepherd calls the ninth 'ten' and the tenth 'nine'.

chapters.title: Rabbi Yochanan on counting by groups
chapters.about: Discussing counting by pairs or hundreds and following the tenth of the count.

chapters.title: Counting backwards and Persian counting
chapters.about: Addressing the validity of counting backwards and how different systems interpret the number one.

chapters.title: Rava's theoretical counting scenarios
chapters.about: Analyzing cases where animals are called nine or ten in various combinations.

chapters.title: The status of calling the tenth animal eleven
chapters.about: Discussing whether calling the tenth animal eleven constitutes uprooting its name.

summary: Rabbi Hidary examines the laws of Ma'asar Behemah, specifically focusing on the counting of animals and the status of animals when counting mistakes occur. He analyzes various scenarios involving counting errors, such as skipping numbers, counting groups, or simultaneous exits, and discusses the resulting holiness of the animals involved.
questions: What happens if a shepherd counts animals incorrectly during Ma'asar Behemah?
Does the tenth animal become holy even if the shepherd does not call it ten?
What is the status of an animal if it is counted as the tenth by mistake?
How do we determine the holiness of animals when two exit the pen simultaneously?
Can a Temurah be made from an animal that was incorrectly counted as the tenth?
